_doc: Nightly capability sweep (scorecard.mjs). Each capability lists the scenarios its lane lines are tagged with and mechanical checks over those runs (scope 'all' widens a check to every run, minus exceptScenarios). A check has better 'lower' or 'higher': lower FAILs above fail and WARNs above warn; higher FAILs below fail and WARNs below warn; a null threshold never fires. maxDrop WARNs (a regression) when the value got worse than the previous night by more than that. A check with no data is WARN, and so is a listed scenario with no scored run. Thresholds were seeded from the 2026-10-21 dev sweep and prod canary so that sweep's BROKEN and DEGRADED rows come out FAIL or WARN. Hand-formatted: one check per line.
